title: ClinicalTrials.gov (API v2)
agency: National Library of Medicine, National Institutes of Health
questions: how many trials by phase or status

manual.how: Run the same search on https://clinicaltrials.gov/ (Advanced Search: condition, intervention, status, phase), click Download, choose CSV (or JSON) with all studies and the needed columns, and upload the file. INSTRUCTIONS.md also lists the API link for the first 1,000 studies.

cache.why: The registry is refreshed often (the /version dataTimestamp was the same morning when checked); data/ is reused within a run.

redistribution.why: ClinicalTrials.gov is a U.S. government service of the National Library of Medicine and its registry data are offered for public reuse; records are submitted by sponsors and some linked documents may carry others' copyright (terms: https://clinicaltrials.gov/about-site/terms-conditions; the page is script-rendered and was not re-read for this pack). Attribute ClinicalTrials.gov.

citation: ClinicalTrials.gov, National Library of Medicine, {dataset}, clinicaltrials.gov API v2, retrieved {retrieved_long}.
clarify: Which statuses count: currently recruiting only, or all trials ever registered (including completed, terminated, withdrawn)?
Interventional trials only, or observational studies too?
Condition match: the condition field (query.cond, includes synonyms) or anywhere in the record (query.term)?
